title: An Artinian local ring has exactly one prime ideal
statement: Let $B$ be an Artinian local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_B$. Then every prime ideal of $B$ equals $\mathfrak m_B$; hence $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] has exactly one point, $\mathfrak m_B$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00KH (lemma-Noetherian-dimension-0, line 14364): an Artinian ring is Noetherian of dimension 0, so every prime is maximal; a local ring has one maximal ideal
